value.summary: Literal scholar of posts, boundaries, and obsolete punctuation who answers questions in charter clauses. Wants the tenth post preserved until authenticated; compares tool marks and legal hands; misses obvious intimidation. Works uneasily with the Nine March Moot. Seeing procedure weaponized against a family makes him interpret law toward its purpose.
cringy shell merchant. Immediate want: seem important to real smugglers. Hidden depth: accidentally holds evidence of Annek's intermediaries.

Dry realist and Copper Rain vintner who answers dragon theories by asking who will repair the channel. Wants runoff stopped; knows terrace hydraulics and labour debts; her family benefited from the old tithe road. Distrusts Kethrian court archivists. She supports truth-telling if farmers receive restitution before spectacle.

Earnest eccentric signal-kite maker who describes people by wind behavior. Wants the extra knots decoded; understands lift, fiber, and plateau weather; assumes every pattern is intentional. Supplies the Tessa Sky College but resents its condescension. Accepting an animal explanation lets her notice the genuine old warning.

Cheerful meddler and Sourapple Ford cider-maker who introduces strangers by assigning them imaginary family resemblances. Wants the cattle crossing restored; reads river depth from reeds and animal behavior; fears her business made her dismiss upstream farmers. Trades honey with Brother Odo and argues warmly with Nessa. She yields on the ford only after seeing a workable route for the autumn drove.
dying pragmatic leader. Immediate want: prevent succession violence. Hidden depth: secretly favours the shepherd who refuses office.
laid-back peat guide. Immediate want: stop soldiers draining safe ground. Hidden depth: maps old Concord ventilation mounds.

Overprepared quarry signaler carrying chalk, bells, coloured cord, spare cord, and notes about the spare cord. Wants the seventh echo restored; maps sound precisely; panics in silence after surviving a collapse. His mentor works at Copperdeep. A nonverbal rescue plan lets him master rather than magically lose his fear.
strict Dry Sock treasurer. Immediate want: prevent state seizure of aid books. Hidden depth: her immaculate accounts expose a cross-border courier cell.
cringy shipyard poet-organizer. Immediate want: make safety demands memorable. Hidden depth: becomes eloquent only when speaking for others.

Cheerful meddler and Orangewake boat librarian who lends books, soup pots, and unsolicited courtship advice. Wants the quarantine children reached safely; reads currents and household needs; has ignored one legitimate health warning before. Knows Houses of Rescue captains. Clear safety conditions turn his defiance into disciplined service.
strict river jurist. Immediate want: stop three courts from clashing. Hidden depth: his family estate benefits from old channel change.

Strict professional stationed at Reed Judge's Rest, with a dry habit of issuing rulings to furniture during rehearsal. Wants the drifting court preserved and cases heard; masters river precedent; fears any improvisation will validate corrupt rivals. Former teacher of an Aur River reformer. A transparent temporary procedure convinces her flexibility can protect law.

Grandiose amateur flood marshal wearing a magnificent sash his aunt made from curtain cloth. Wants every neighborhood evacuated safely; knows boats and kitchens, not command; covers uncertainty with speeches. Adored and corrected by Three Spoon cooks. He grows when he delegates publicly and keeps responsibility.
laid-back caravan master. Immediate want: reopen scrub route safely. Hidden depth: saw glass locusts following a warm underground line.
warm, politically cautious ruler. Immediate want: restore missing villages to rolls. Hidden depth: fears exposing royal tax complicity.
charming, conflict-avoidant ruler. Immediate want: contain blight panic. Hidden depth: knows court land rests on lost water records.
sociable, anxious, decent ruler. Immediate want: complete wedding without erasing island rights. Hidden depth: willing to postpone, advisers are not.
observant sixteen-year-old. Immediate want: be treated as a learner, not a symbol. Hidden depth: hears false bell patterns others miss.
stern, attentive, exhausted monarch. Immediate want: fund forts without starving boroughs. Hidden depth: knows the mine decline is worse than published.
